race.comment: BRIGINSHAW (6) is an honest campaigner who is yet to miss a drum in five career outings and looks the runner in this line-up with the most upside. Gets Cormack on board to navigate from the sticky draw and shouldn't be discounted lightly. TOUCH BASE (4) has been plying his trade in Saturday metro grade of late and will find this assignment much more to his liking. Watch for a spike in form. VERY GOOD (5) will be rock-hard fit for this and looks one for the exotics players. NOTTINGTON PRINCE (2) resumes here but has won when fresh before and saves his best form for this sprint journey. Include from the inside alley.
